SD57-002.name: The Six Heaven Falcon
SD57-002.effect:
Flash - [High Speed]
This card in Hand can be summoned by paying the cost with cores in the Reserve. In this case, cores to be put on this Spirit must also be from the Reserve.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Either put a core from the Void each to two Purple Spirits you control, or put two cores from the Void to a Grandwalker Nexus with two colors or more you control. This effect can only be used once per turn.

[LV2]
This Spirit’s color and symbol are also treated as Purple.

SD57-X01.name: Queen Oichi
SD57-X01.effect:
Flash - (Either Attack Step)
If you control any six-colored Spirit/Nexus, you can summon this card from the Hand by paying two costs.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned/Attacks)
During this turn, treat this Spirit's color as colorless, and send two cores from the opposing Field to the Reserve.

[LV2][LV3]
When this Spirit would leave the Field due to the opponent, you can summon a six-colored Spirit card from your Trash, without paying the cost.

SD57-CP01.name: Tenma Nobunaga
SD57-CP01.effect:
[Grandwalker Nexus]
This Nexus can only be affected by effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses. Cores can only be placed on this Nexus via Core Charge or effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses, and cannot be moved from this Nexus except via effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses.

[Core Charge: (Heavenly Demon King/Evil Shadow/Clever Machine/Machine Beast & Cost 3 or more)]
◆When you Summon/Advent a target Spirit, you can put a core from the Void to this Nexus.
◆When this Nexus is deployed, if you do not control a Grandwalker Nexus with the same card name, you can send three cards from your decktop to the Trash. For each target card among them, put a core from the Void to this Nexus.

[LV1][LV2]
This Nexus's symbol is also treated as Red/Purple/Green/Yellow/Blue.

[Grand Skill: 2] [LV1][LV2] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
(Once per turn, send two cores from this Nexus to the Void) For each symbol color you have, send a core from an opposing Spirit to the Reserve.

[Grand Field] [LV2]
Fulfill one symbol color for the conditions of your [Six Heaven Rush]/[Six Heaven Rebirth].

SD57-005.name: The HeavenlyDemonKing Weapons
SD57-005.effect:
[Brave Condition: Heavenly Demon King/Evil Shadow & Cost 4 or more]

[LV1] (When Summoned)
Draw a card.

[During Brave]
While braved to a "God-Sechs"-named Spirit, this Spirit's symbols are also treated as Red/Purple/Green/White/Yellow/Blue.

SD57-TX01.name: The HeavenlyDemonKing God-Sechs -Type Earth-
SD57-TX01.effect:
This card/Spirit is also treated as being named "The HeavenlyDemonKing God-Sechs".

[LV1][LV2][LV3]
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Spirit/Magic effects.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Discard an opposing Burst, and once per turn, refresh this Spirit.

[LV2][LV3] Six Heaven Rebirth: 5 or less Counters (Only one Rebirth can be used at a time)
When this Spirit attacks, you can flip it. If you have five or more colors of symbols, instead, you can flip it, sending an opposing Life to the Trash.

SD57-006.name: The HeavenlyDemonKing God-Sechs -Type Final-
SD57-006.effect:
[+1]

[LV1] (When Reborn)
Return an opposing Spirit to the deckbottom.
[Six Heaven Rush: 5]
If you have five or more symbol colors, destroy five opposing non-"Primal" family Grandwalker Nexuses.

[LV1] [Return to Prime]
When it would leave the Field due to an opposing effect, you can flip and deploy it.

SD57-TX01-A10706.name: The HeavenlyDemonKing God-Sechs -Type Heaven-
SD57-TX01-A10706.effect:
[+1]

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Reborn/Attacks)
Send three cores from any opposing Spirits/Ultimates to the Trash.
[Six Heaven Rush: 5]
If you have five or more colors of symbols, this effect can't be prevented by opposing effects.

[LV2][LV3]
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Spirit/Magic effects.
[Six Heaven Rush: 6]
If you have six colors of symbols, all your Spirits can't be blocked.

SD57-X02.name: The HeavenlyDemonKing God-Sechs -Type Shadow-
SD57-X02.effect:
[Tenma-Kagemusha]
When your "Heavenly Demon King" family Spirit(s) are targeted by an opposing effect, you can summon this card from the Hand. Then, choose to either change the target of that effect to this Spirit only, or change the "opponent"/"opposing" text(s) of that effect to "you"/"your", and if it's the latter option, the opponent chooses the target.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks/Blocks)
Send a core from any opposing Spirit to the Reserve.
[Six Heaven Rush: 3] (Activate if you have three or more symbol colors)
Draw two cards.

SD57-001.name: The Six Heaven Soldier
SD57-001.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
You can reveal three cards from your decktop. Among them, add a "HeavenlyDemon" Grandwalker Nexus card, and a "Heavenly Demon King"/"Evil Shadow"/"Clever Machine" family Spirit card, except "The Six Heaven Soldier", to the Hand. Discard any remaining card(s).

[LV2] (Your Main Step)
This Spirit gains an extra Red symbol and an extra White symbol.

SD57-004.name: The Six Heaven Conjurer
SD57-004.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Draw a card.
[Rush: Red/White]
(While you have a Red/White symbol, the following effects activate next)
[Red Core]: You can destroy an opposing Nexus.
[White Core]: Return an opposing Spirit to the Hand.

[LV2][LV3]
This Spirit's symbol is also treated as Red/White.

SD57-003.name: The Six Heaven Head
SD57-003.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
You can reveal three cards from your decktop. Among them, add a "HeavenlyDemon" and an exactly-named "The Owari World" to the Hand. Discard any remaining cards.

[LV1][LV2]
The Spirit's symbol is also treated as Red/Green/White/Yellow/Blue.

[LV2]
All exactly-named "The HeavenlyDemonKing God-Sechs" in your Hand become Cost 6.
